user.title: Silence Scooter Configuration
user.description: Configure trip detection parameters and electricity tariff.

data.use_tracked_distance: Use manual tracked counters (resettable after scooter mods)
data.multi_device: Multi-scooter mode (adds IMEI to entity names)
data.tracker_min_distance: Minimum distance between two GPS points (metres)

data_description.tariff_sensor: Select your dynamic tariff sensor (or leave sensor.tarif_base_ttc to use the default one)
data_description.outdoor_temp_source: Choose the temperature sensor for trip history: scooter's built-in sensor (available when connected) or an external weather sensor
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Select an external temperature sensor (required if 'External weather sensor' is selected above)
data_description.use_tracked_distance:
✅ Enabled: Statistics based on manual counters (resettable after scooter prep/mods)
❌ Disabled: Statistics based on global odometer (ODO) and MQTT energy counters
data_description.multi_device: Enable if you have or plan to have multiple scooters. Entities will be named 'sensor.silence_scooter_9012_speed' instead of 'sensor.silence_scooter_speed' for better grouping.
data_description.device_tracker_enabled: Native GPS tracker fed by the MQTT latitude/longitude sensors (replaces the deprecated device_tracker.see service). Uncheck if you track the scooter another way (Traccar, OwnTracks…).
data_description.tracker_min_distance: A point closer than this distance to the previous one is ignored: smooths the trace when parked or at red lights. 0 = no filtering. Impossible jumps (> 120 km/h) are always rejected.
data_description.confirmation_delay: Filters sensor oscillations and network micro-cuts before considering the scooter stopped (recommended: 120s, increase in weak zones)
data_description.pause_max_duration: Max time with scooter OFF before trip ends. Quick errand < 5min = pause, > 5min = end
data_description.watchdog_delay: If no communication during this duration, the trip stops (e.g.: garage without network)
data_description.connectivity_loss_tolerance: When the scooter stops communicating (tunnel, dead zone, module re-registering) without having reported a stop, the trip stays open for this long before being closed, with an end time set to the last frame received. Set it above the maximum pause duration (recommended: 15 min). The watchdog waits at least this long.

error.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of this integration is allowed
error.confirmation_delay_too_low: Confirmation delay must be at least 30 seconds
error.confirmation_delay_too_high: Confirmation delay cannot exceed 600 seconds (10 minutes)
error.pause_duration_too_low: Pause duration must be at least 1 minute
error.watchdog_delay_too_low: Watchdog delay must be at least 1 minute
error.sensor_not_found: The selected sensor does not exist
error.temp_entity_required: You must select an external temperature sensor when 'External weather sensor' is chosen

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of this integration is allowed

reset_tracked_counters.name: Reset manual counters
reset_tracked_counters.description: Resets the tracked distance and battery counters to zero. Use this after major scooter modifications (tuning, battery change, etc.) to start fresh statistics.
